international.title: Mandelson tried to set up meeting between Trump adviser and lobbying firm he held shares in
international.summary: Then ambassador to US wanted to discuss alternatives to World Trade Organisation in ‘under the radar’ meeting, documents reveal UK politics live – latest updates Peter Mandelson sought to organise an “under the radar” meeting between an economic adviser to Donald Trump and a member of his former lobbying firm, Global Counsel, while he still held shares in the company, newly released documents reveal. In April 2025, while ambassador to Washington, Mandelson wanted to hold a lunch to discuss “alternative options” to the World Trade Organisation and on how “likeminded partners come to terms with China and its practices”. He told the economic adviser he wanted to bring “a former trade colleague of mine” with “interesting views” who could “lead off”. He added: “It would be best to keep this under the radar”.
